absurd_sentence: The report wrote the same eviction case out again and again, and counted each copy as another time he was sued.
who_does_the_stupid_thing: the machine that assembles the report, which copies one court case and advances its own count for every copy
why_absurd_not_just_bad: It is not wrong about anything. Every copy is accurate, and being accurate that many times is what makes the total false.
